description: List the subscription brands a business could offer its users through Fleek in a market, subscriptions first and ranked by how big they are there (up to 15). Filter by market (ISO code like AE, a country name, or a region like GCC or Europe), by category (subscription, gift_card, streaming, music, sports, ai, productivity, audiobooks, anime, shopping, food, gaming, travel) and by a free-text brand query. If the market is not covered, the result says so and names the nearest covered markets.

category.description: subscription, gift_card, or a type such as streaming, music, sports, ai.

market.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code (AE), country name (United Arab Emirates) or region (GCC, Europe).

query.description: Part of a brand name, e.g. 'netflix'.

name: search_catalogue
title: Search Fleek's catalogue
